This role will be pivotal in expanding our footprint in the European area and also be of great help to the growing client engagement team.

jobs.description_text: Chez Mirego, nous croyons profondément en une approche itérative souple et collaborative de la création de produits numériques. jobs.title: Director of Agricultural Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of Agricultural Development, you will own our engagement with the U.S. Department of Agriculture and the agricultural community in Washington. You will build the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that connect precipitation enhancement to the conservation and water supply needs of American producers, and you will own the Congressional relationships and coalition presence that make the work durable. This position is based in Washington, DC. Significant stock options with high potential upside as an early-stage company 401(k) with employer matching Full health coverage (medical, dental, and vision insurance) Relocation assistance provided (if applicable) Unlimited PTO Paid parental leave for both parents

jobs.title: Director of International Development
jobs.description_text: Rainmaker is pioneering a modern precipitation enhancement cloud seeding system to solve water scarcity. We develop and incorporate radar validation, weather-resistant UAS, and numerical weather modeling to make water abundant. As Rainmaker’s Director of International Development, you will be the bridge between Rainmaker’s International Team and the U.S. federal government. You will own our engagement with the Department of State by building the programs, partnerships, and funding pathways that pair American precipitation enhancement technology with the water security needs of partner nations. Water scarcity is a geopolitical problem before it is a technical one. Rainmaker’s goal is to make American cloud seeding the technology partner nations turn to, and this role is how we get there in Washington. This position is based in Washington, DC and works as an embedded member of the International Team. jobs.title: Senior Technical Lead - Radio Intelligent Controller Systems
jobs.description_text: Parallel Wireless is reimagining mobile networks with innovative, energy-efficient Open RAN solutions. Join us as we lead the future of telecommunications, driving innovation through green and sustainable networks. Learn more about our mission, vision and values. We are looking for a Senior Technical Lead who is comfortable operating across the entire system, from low-level Linux and networking problems to the architecture of large Go and Kubernetes-based distributed systems. This role is for someone who can investigate a Linux kernel or networking issue in the morning, review a concurrency problem in Go before lunch, design a multi-service distributed flow in the afternoon, and help debug a C++ component when production behavior does not match expectations. You do not need to be the deepest specialist in every technology we use. You do need the technical range, curiosity, and systems thinking to move between layers quickly and understand how they affect one another. Our team owns RIC Systems end to end, including Near-RT RIC, Non-RT RIC, infrastructure, messaging, state management, network-facing components, microservices, deployment, performance, reliability, and production troubleshooting. We are looking for someone who wants that breadth.

jobs.title: Technical Lead, Artificial Intelligence
jobs.description_text: We are building the AI layer of the Radio Access Network, applying agentic AI, machine learning, and LLMs to real RAN challenges — from network operations and root cause analysis to PHY simulation and uplink link adaptation. This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role, combining architecture, coding, technical leadership, and mentorship. You will work from our Kfar Saba site alongside RAN, PHY, and software teams, building production-grade AI solutions for real cellular networks.

jobs.description_text:
About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

Great brands help make Pinners’ inspirations a reality, and we’re looking for a Client Account Manager II

jobs.description_text:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft is seeking an Analyst to join our Business Forecast & Planning team within Customer Care Operations. This role owns the forecasting, capacity, and scheduling models that keep our global support workforce sized and staffed correctly. You'll work hands-on with our BPO partners to translate demand signals into staffing plans, and bring deep contact centre planning expertise to a team managing support at scale across multiple sites and geographies.

Responsibilities:

  • Support the development and upkeep of the models and frameworks that connect business drivers to staffing and resourcing decisions
  • Translate large, complex, and sometimes ambiguous data into clear, actionable insights that support leadership recommendations
  • Own day-to-day planning execution, from dashboards maintenance and reporting to business reviews, with a sharp focus on accuracy and the details that matter
  • Leverage AI tools to build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analyses that support the team's recommendations and insights
  • Identify and help drive opportunities to improve how the team plans and operates
  • Move quickly on ambiguous, time-sensitive requests, using modern tools to work smarter and faster

Data is at the heart of Lyft’s products and decision-making. You will leverage data and rigorous, analytical thinking to shape our products and make business decisions. This will involve performing rigorous product deep dives, identifying opportunities for product enhancements, and measuring the impact of product changes.

The Airports team, within the Driver organization, focuses on the airport marketplace and the unique products designed for this use case. Airports are one of the most important, impactful, and complex parts of Lyft’s Rideshare business, as they are a key part of both the rider and driver Lyft experience and have unique dynamics. As an Analytics Lead on the Airport team, you will collaborate with our team of engineers, product managers, and designers to conduct thorough data deep dives on airport performance, challenge our current strategy, and recommend enhancements to facilitate market growth.

The ideal candidate can apply strong business acumen to propose product and marketplace changes, and is comfortable working with a highly cross functional team. In this role, you will help us tackle problems such as:

  • How should we determine pricing and earnings for airport rides? 
  • Who are our current airport drivers and what segment can we focus on to

jobs.description_text: About the role This role is about performance development, not performance management. Unity's approach to performance is built on genuine ownership and accountability, not a traditional annual review cycle — but the system itself isn't the point. The point is helping people actually grow into what that ownership requires: sharper judgement, stronger client and commercial instincts, real skill in giving and using feedback, and the behaviours that take someone from new joiner to trusted senior contributor. This role exists to build that growth, not to run the administrative mechanics of reviews and calibration. It's about coaching Partners and Functional Leaders to develop their people well, giving every new joiner a genuine development runway from day one, and building the skills, frameworks and programmes that help people grow faster and more deliberately than they would simply by doing the job. Classic L&D sits inside this, but the mandate is bigger: making sure people are developing, not just being assessed. jobs.description_text: About Smartnumbers We are on a mission to stop fraud and improve customer authentication. Fraud is a huge problem affecting millions of people, it costs the UK nearly £7bn and represents 40% of all crime. Too often the solution has been to put in place cumbersome authentication processes that frustrate genuine customers, cause inefficiencies for organisations and fail to prevent fraud. We are changing this by providing organisations with real-time insight into the risk of a caller. We combine patented machine learning technology with our industry consortium to help identify and prevent contact centre fraud. We also provide clients with real-time insight into the authenticity of the call by leveraging our unique network access and relationships. We recognise that we need to work together to fight fraud, that is why we have fostered strategic partnerships with leading global organisations like Amazon, BT, and Genesys.
